texto: # Dockerized-AI-Tic-Tac-Toe-Lab 🤖 AI Tic Tac Toe Lab An advanced AI vs AI Tic Tac Toe simulation platform built using Streamlit + LLM agents. This project demonstrates: Multi-agent interaction Turn-based reasoning Real-time UI updates Model benchmarking (latency & behavior) 🚀 Features 🎮 Core Gameplay AI vs AI Tic Tac Toe Turn-based execution Automatic move validation Game state tracking (Win / Draw) 🤖 Multi-Agent System Two independent AI agents: Player X Player O Each agent uses a different LLM model Supports: OpenAI (GPT models) Extendable to Claude / Gemini / Groq ⚡ Latency Tracking (if you extend) Measures response time per move Compare model performance Helps analyze: Speed vs intelligence tradeoff 🧠 Smart Decision Making Agents are prompted with: Current board state Valid moves Strategy instructions 🎨 UI (Streamlit) Interactive game board Live updates per move Model selection dropdown Clean minimal design 🏗️ Project Structure tic-tac-toe-ai/ │ ├── app.py # Main Streamlit app ├── agents.py # AI agents logic ├── requirements.txt ├── .env │ ├── game/ │ └── board.py # Game engine │ ├── utils/ │ └── helpers.py # Parsing utilities │ └── components/ └── ui_board.py # UI rendering ⚙️ How It Works (Flow) 🔄 Game Flow Start Game ↓ Initialize Board ↓ Player X turn ↓ Send board state → AI Agent ↓ Agent returns move ↓ Validate move ↓ Update board ↓ Check win/draw ↓ Switch player ↓ Repeat 🧠 Agent Workflow Each AI agent receives: Board: X|O| |X| | |O Valid Moves: [(0,2), (1,0), ...] Instruction: Return ONLY row col Agent responds: 📊 Internal Component 1. Game Engine (board.py) 2. Handles: Board state Move validation Winner detection 3. Agents (agents.py) 4. 5. Wraps LLM models Defines behavior via prompts Ensures structured output 4. UI Layer (app.py) 5. Controls game loop Displays board Handles user interaction 5. Utilities (helpers.py) 6. Extracts moves from LLM output Prevents crashes from bad responses 🔥 Advanced Features (You Can Add) 📊 Analytics Dashboard Move latency chart Win rate per model Average response time 🧠 Explainable AI Show reasoning of each move Compare strategies between models 🏆 Leaderboard System Track wins per model ELO rating system 🎮 Human vs AI Mode User plays against LLM 🔁 Tournament Mode Run 100+ games automatically Generate statistics ☁️ Deployment Streamlit Cloud Docker container HuggingFace Spaces 🛠️ Installation git clone https://github.com/your-username/tic-tac-toe-ai.git cd tic-tac-toe-ai python -m venv venv venv\Scripts\activate # Windows pip install -r requirements.txt 🔑 Environment Setup Create .env file: OPENAI_API_KEY=your_api_key_here ▶️ Run the App streamlit run app.py 🐳 Docker (Optional) docker build -t tic-tac-toe-ai . docker run -p 8501:8501 tic-tac-toe-ai 📌 Key Learnings Multi-agent coordination Prompt engineering LLM structured outputs Real-time UI with Streamlit AI benchmarking 🧠 Tech Stack Python 3.11 Streamlit OpenAI API Agno Framework Matplotlib (optional analytics) 📈 Future Scope Reinforcement learning agents Neural network-based players Real-time multiplayer Game generalization (Connect-4, Chess) 👨‍💻 Author Vaishnav Mandapati
